Use case: photorealistic-natural. WhiskedAway countryside coastal inn, same real building as Cuddlecore. Editorial cosy-living INTERIORS PHOTOGRAPH, not render/illustration. Full-frame 24mm lens, 1.6m eye height, level verticals, f/4 reasonably sharp, ONE 16:9 landscape image. Cream #f4efe4 uneven limewashed plaster, low aged oak beams, dark honey wide floorboards, rubbed oak door wood, cream painted frames, aged brass #b07f52 and deep brown #2c2416. Faded berry #8b4d5c/cream/faded-blue woven runner. Natural chips, wear, faded textiles, no showroom polish. Same rainy late afternoon: cool soft sea-window/fanlight daylight and two modest brass wall lamps, thin warm light under a few doors. Asset: 01-entrance-hall.png, the entrance hall just inside front door, looking straight toward the SEA.
Input references: image 1 Cuddlecore front wall is materials/light/photo realism only, not its kitchen layout; image 2 materials board is exact material/palette reference only; image 3 Cuddlecore back wall supplies the room-door family (old four-panel oak, cream frame, round aged brass knob). Do NOT include kitchen furnishings or the cat.
Geometry authoritative: wide SHALLOW entrance hall across front of house, about 10.8m wide and 2.2m deep. From its center a narrow STRAIGHT 1.8m wide corridor runs 8m toward a single tall sash window overlooking gray rainy sea at the FAR END. No bends or branches.
Camera just inside front door on centerline; front door/fanlight are BEHIND camera. Look through a simple cream-trimmed rectangular hallway opening centered in photograph.
Staircase rises along LEFT side of ENTRANCE HALL only, with turned oak banister, naturally worn runner and a small low closed cellar door under it; do not put stairs inside narrow corridor. Oak-framed cork notice board on wall immediately RIGHT of centered corridor opening, five or six blank cream papers pinned with brass pins, no marks resembling writing. A simple boot bench/wood coat pegs and umbrella stand can sit toward entrance hall sides, uncluttered.
Corridor contains EXACTLY FOUR room doors, TWO per wall, all same old four-panel oak family as image 3: nearest left bakery, farther left Cuddlecore; nearest right apothecary, farther right Flourish. No extra doors. Each has one 20cm round aged brass dial on wall beside it at 1.3m height, always on the door's FRONT-DOOR side (nearer this camera), not sea-window side. Dial is small, blank segments with pointer, no writing. Farther RIGHT door slightly ajar with warm light and a hint of greenery. One slender dark oak grandfather clock stands on LEFT corridor wall between its two doors, avoiding all four doorways. Face has simple hour dots/bars, absolutely NO numerals. One continuous faded berry/cream/blue runner follows corridor to sea window. Two small brass wall lamps, restrained warm light.
Prioritize real buildable proportions, stairs LEFT, notice board RIGHT of opening, sea window centered at end, visible clock and coherent long corridor. No labels or diagram overlays.
